known_limitations: V2 T−1 interpretation note: the dispatch's raw formula 'value of d usable from d 16:15 ET' would nominally admit the decision Friday's own VIX close (16:15<17:00); the engine applies the design-draft §3.4 uniform T−1 buffer (obs_date <= decision_date-1) so a Friday decision consumes THURSDAY's close, reproducing the PIT_DOSSIER G-PIT-V2 application sentence ('Friday 17:00 ET decision consumes Thursday's close, margin 24h45m >= 24h'). Strictly conservative direction (costs staleness, never lookahead). Documented in state_engine.py INTERPRETATION NOTE.

Percentile convention: weak/inclusive rank over the trailing 252 usable observations INCLUDING the current value; a constant series ranks p100 (documented; irrelevant on real data, exercised deliberately in tests).

Episode merge is episode-accounting only (shared episode_id for same-state runs separated by <4 weekly observations); it never rewrites weekly effective_state values - rewriting would fabricate state during intervening weeks incl. ABSTAIN weeks (fail-closed law).

ABSTAIN bypasses min-dwell and is effective immediately; re-entry into a tradeable state after an abstain run again needs 2 consecutive observations (the first post-abstain week stays effectively ABSTAIN).
episode_id numbering is chain-global from the panel epoch (first computable Friday 2016-04-08 on the real panel), so calendar-window episodes start at EP024; stable and deterministic.

F3 (>=26 state-true weeks per 26-week fold) requires full-fold occupancy per fold - structurally brutal for a 4+1 state partition; margins reported as frozen, never relaxed (all five states NOT_RUN_THIN; per design §3.5 the router degenerates toward the always-eligible book - a first-class outcome).

Drawdown-hysteresis battery covers only the 5 FX symbols in this data plane (XAU/XAG/BRENT/WTI/NATGAS tapes are L1 scope); USDCAD/AUDUSD D1 closes come from the sparse ancestor-convention ANC H1 panels.

EURUSD RV30 percentile uses the available window (>=63 obs) for the first 15 Fridays of the calendar (D1 panel starts 2021-01; full 252-obs windows only from ~2022-02); disclosed in the report, n=271 overlap weeks.
Battery MD/JSON embed provenance (command, runtimes, timestamp) which varies across runs; the deterministic core is certified by payload_sha256 which re-runs must reproduce (verified once).
